title: Separate status axes
description: Seven independent axes. A value on one axis never sets another (Architecture section 6, Document Studio 3, Ingestion 4). There is deliberately no single 'verified' field. Every axis value carries its basis.

source_integrity.description: Are these the exact bytes we claim? BYTE_VERIFIED = re-hashed against an independently held manifest at a pinned revision.

source_authenticity.description: Is the copy what it purports to be (issuer, identity, fidelity)? Mirrors SOURCE_AUTHORITY_POLICY v1; never raised by Admin publication.

evidence_fidelity.description: Has the extracted text, field or candidate been checked against the source page?

legal_applicability.description: Temporal and scope applicability. NOT_ESTABLISHED is the default; nothing in Cycle 13 raises it without a recorded decision.

legal_approval.description: Document Studio 3.3 tiers. While AUTH-LEDGER is at version 0 and no Legal Reviewer is appointed, every release record must be T0_RESEARCH_ONLY (enforced by the validator, rule LEDGER_V0_NO_APPROVAL).

publication.description: Distribution inside the app. Publication is never legal approval. EXCLUDED_RESTRICTED marks an item barred by the restricted-material register; such items must not appear in a release bundle at all.

dependency_freshness.description: Whether downstream items built on this record are current for their checked scope.

basis.description: Why this value: tool, rule or review record. Never empty.

evidence_ref.description: Repository path, review id or approval id supporting the value.

approval_ref.description: Approval record id. Required by rule for any legal_approval above T0.
